narrationTexts: Both bugs confirmed. Fixing options.js first, then retryPolicy.js, and rebuilding to check for the second bug.
finalText:
**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both now fixed:

1. [options.js:6](src/core/options.js) — bundler renamed `retries` to `retryCount`, but this call site still read `options.retries`, which was `undefined`. Crashed on `.toFixed(0)`.
2. [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js) — new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. The strict check only handled `true`/`false` and threw on `undefined`. Now treats anything not `true` as disabled.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the dep bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc), not errors.

Next: nothing.
